front: Why is aluminium used for aircraft?
Why is aluminium used for overhead power cables?
back: Low density and good electrical conductivity.
notes: Usually wound around a steel core for strength.

front: Why is aluminium used for food containers?
Why is copper used for electrical wiring?
back: Very good electrical conductivity and ductility.

front: Which properties are considered when choosing a metal?
back: Density, strength, conductivity, corrosion resistance, melting point, appearance, cost and availability.
Catalysts in catalytic converters (also jewellery and laboratory equipment).
Jewellery and electrical connectors: lustrous, malleable, a good conductor, and it never corrodes.
Rechargeable lithium-ion batteries: least dense metal, gives a high voltage.
Alloyed with iron to make stainless steel, which resists corrosion.
Construction (frames, reinforcing bars), machinery and vehicles: strong and cheap.
